messages:
alba: Opening a cleanup/follow-up thread for Velaris Dedicated postmortem. Summary: transient VPC peering flap + vendor firewall GR bug resulted in stale next-hops and tenant isolation ~1h10m. Need owners for remediation, onboarding shields, and a short detection lambda. Tagging @hugo @sylvie.

hugo: From captures: their firewall (vendor X) drops graceful-restart state in certain restart sequences. Also saw management plane briefly blocked by an ACL rule for ~12m which delayed our route refresh. Two tracks: immediate detection + short timer tweak; longer term: onboarding compatibility gate.

sylvie: I can own the detection and runbook. Plan: synthetic prefix check every 40s, require 2 misses -> auto-collect (BGP snapshot + mgmt ping) -> page oncall. Prototype ETA 2026-04-06. Will tune to avoid noise.

carmen: I'll coordinate customer comms and firmware dialog. Velaris agreed to a staged firmware probe in staging and provided config snapshot. They've scheduled staging window 2026-04-08 02:00-03:00 UTC.

alba: Action items (owner -> ETA):
- hugo -> PR with recommended hold-timer tweak + config diff -> 2026-03-31
- sylvie -> synthetic prefix lambda + playbook -> 2026-04-06
- carmen -> customer coordination + canary plan -> 2026-04-05
- infra -> add onboarding field: "firewall image + GR support" -> 2026-04-10

hugo: Quick lab note: lowering hold timer to 3/9 in sim cut reconverge median from ~72s -> ~15s. Where vendor supports GR, enable it; otherwise lower timers. Will push draft PR.

sylvie: Posted staging dashboard link (internal) and tuned thresholds to require 2 consecutive misses and confirm mgmt-unreachable before paging.

oncall-bot: Incident 2026-04-02-501 created: Velaris Dedicated peering isolation 1 follow-ups added. Link: https://incidents.redwood/2026/501

carmen: After staging canary, if green we'll schedule prod rollout and a 24h observation window. Will post results here.

alba: Thanks team. If we confirm this pattern (firewall GR + mgmt ACLs) across tenants, escalate to platform guardrail. Sync scheduled 2026-04-09 11:00 PT to close items. Closing thread unless new issues surface. :thumbsup:
